# Goals

The goals of this milestone are as follows:

-   Create a data dictionary

# Instructions

Make some progress, evidenced by commits to your repo since project milestone 2. 
These commits should

-   add a data dictionary to the `README.md` file in the `data` folder describing each variable in your chosen dataset,
-   explicitly close issues opened as proposal feedback, and
-   make further progress on the project.
